bsi.editorial_reason: Genesis 36:11-12 specifically lists the sons of Eliphaz and Eliphaz's concubine Timna (Amalek), a different son of Esau than Reuel. Reuel appears at 36:10 and his own sons at 36:13. These two verses must not be attributed as key personal evidence to Esau's separate son Reuel.
editorial_evidence: Pinned WLC Genesis 36:10 names Reuel alongside Eliphaz as distinct sons of Esau
Pinned WLC Genesis 36:11-12 names descendants of Eliphaz only, not Reuel
